entry.title: The Two Paradigms of AI
entry.summary: Language models and world models have each succeeded on their own terms. AGI will come from unifying them correctly, not from choosing between them.

entry.title: The LLM is the New Compiler: Moving From “Vibe Coding” to Intent-Based Engineering
entry.summary: If the LLM is a compiler, the natural-language blueprint is the source of truth — and “vibe coding” has to grow up into intent-based engineering.
